[...] This paper's findings are fundamental to the core hypothesis of KIVI. The authors of KIVI explicitly state that their observation of persistent, large-magnitude outliers in fixed channels of the key cache aligns with previous findings in the AWQ paper, providing a critical justification for their decision to quantize the key cache per-channel. ©2026 Liner. All Rights Reserved. [...] KIVI quantizes key cache per-channel and value cache per-token based on extensive analysis of outlier patterns and quantization error in KV cache.
 KIVI is a plug-and-play 2-bit KV cache quantization algorithm with hardware-friendly implementation that does not require fine-tuning.
 KIVI incorporates a grouped key cache and a residual key cache, maintaining the residual portion in full precision to handle streaming data and ensure accuracy.
